text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"organized letter opening and closing","quality":"text structure","description":"The essay uses a recognizable overall format with a greeting, body paragraphs, and a closing that helps the writing feel more controlled."},{"evidence":"clear topic sentences like \"My initial reason\" and \"In additon\"","quality":"paragraph organization","description":"The essay signals shifts between points more clearly, making the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"the current school's lunch menu is technically healthy\"","quality":"sentence clarity","description":"The essay more often states ideas in a straightforward way that can be understood without heavy effort."},{"evidence":"\"changing the menu wouldn't be necessary, it would be a waste of time and money\"","quality":"development of reasons","description":"The essay gives reasons that are more directly connected to the claim and somewhat better explained."},{"evidence":"\"our current food consists of fruits,vegetables and also green salad\"","quality":"specific support","description":"The essay includes more concrete details to support its position rather than relying mainly on broad generalities."}]}
